verses.1: A prayer for Asaf, but it’s better for Israel that God blesses them with peace in their hearts.
verses.2: And my feet are somewhat limp, as if they have been soaked in water.
verses.3: For I long to see those wicked people suffer.
verses.4: For there is no remedy for their deaths; whether they are alive or dead.
verses.5: In human labor, one cannot do anything; and with a person, nothing can be accomplished.
verses.6: Therefore, their pride will be covered by shame and disgrace.
verses.7: He went out from his mother’s womb; his veins were already open.
verses.8: They will speak evil of one another. They will slander each other.
verses.9: They will eat from the heavens, and their voices will be heard throughout the earth.
verses.10: Therefore, his people will return, and from the sea, they will be brought back to him.
verses.11: And they said, “How can anyone know? There’s no way to know.”
verses.12: Look, these are the wicked and those who have lived a life of sin.
verses.13: But I have been given a heart, and I can wash my face in his tears.
verses.14: And I am sad every day; my heart breaks at dawn.
verses.15: If I say that, then I’m telling you about your ancestors.
verses.16: And I thought to myself that this was his hard work in my eyes.
verses.17: Until I reach the holy places of our Father.
verses.18: But in some cases, they were thrown into the abyss.
verses.19: How long was it before they were rescued from the depths of despair?
verses.20: May their imaginations be destroyed in the city; may their faces be hidden from sight.
verses.21: For my heart and all my limbs are burning with anger.
verses.22: And I am in pain, and I do not know what I was like when I was with you.
verses.23: And I will always be with you. You hold my right hand.
verses.24: By your wisdom, you will guide me; and with your kindness, you will take me away.
verses.25: I have no place in the heavens, and with you, I do not desire to be on earth.
verses.26: All my limbs and heart are united together; my parts belong to God forever.
verses.27: For behold, your days are waning; all your strength is departing from you.
verses.28: And I am close to God. May it be good for me that I have Jehovah as my protector, so that He can record all my deeds.
